name: Hroniki Izabelly
source:
Chronicles of Isabella is a visual novel about how, in the span of a single day, your whole life can turn into hell. Isabella, a young and hot sorceress, comes to visit her best friend to spend some cold December evenings with her.

Play snowballs, drink mulled wine, sit by the fireplace and confess your love - all the things that childhood friends usually do together. But Isabella is met not only by her best friend Maria, but also by the already middle-aged Baron von Krautz, who also aims to take the heart of a young lady.

Isabella is not the most restrained sorceress in the world - she never reaches into her pocket for a word and does not allow herself to be offended.

This is the beginning of the end for their relationship, and a deadly strike to the heart of the unfortunate Isabella.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230329101215/https://wanderergame.itch.io/chronicles-of-isabella]Itch.io[/url]]

Chronicles of Isabella is also a prequel to another game, [url=https://wanderergame.itch.io/wanderer-game]"Wanderer"[/url].
translation:
《伊莎贝拉编年史》是一部讲述短短一天之内，整个人生如何沦为地狱的视觉小说。年轻火辣的女术士伊莎贝拉前去拜访自己的挚友，准备与她共度十二月里几个寒冷的夜晚。

打雪仗、喝热红酒、围坐在壁炉旁倾诉爱意——这些都是青梅竹马通常会一起做的事。然而迎接伊莎贝拉的不仅有她的挚友玛丽亚，还有已步入中年的冯·克劳茨男爵，他也企图博取这位年轻姑娘的芳心。

伊莎贝拉绝非世上最懂克制的女术士——她向来唇枪舌剑，也绝不容许自己受半点冒犯。

这成了她们关系破裂的开端，也是对不幸的伊莎贝拉内心的致命一击。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230329101215/https://wanderergame.itch.io/chronicles-of-isabella]Itch.io[/url]]

《伊莎贝拉编年史》同时也是另一款游戏[url=https://wanderergame.itch.io/wanderer-game]《Wanderer》[/url]的前传。
